motivation.design_change: Retain every source particle at its original macro weight and add only co-located neutral pairs, eliminating charge-profile thinning.
motivation.question: Does exact source-charge retention reach the unchanged transient gates at reference-scale density without an ionization launch?

initial_state.known_correlation: Added velocities are deterministic resamples of the source pairing pool and are not independent draws.

decision_rule.prospective_threshold_basis: The physics thresholds are unchanged from both prior prospective follow-ups and remain tied to the locked control.
admissible_for_density_diagnostic_only_i: all four cycles pass numerical hard gates
first-cycle ionization does not exceed twice the locked control
first-cycle electron wall loss remains at least one quarter of the locked control
first-cycle total population growth does not exceed 1.02
sampled absolute electric field does not exceed 1.25 times the locked control

claim_boundary: This prospective follow-up tests a charge-exact density augmentation with correlated velocity resampling. Passing makes it admissible for a later density diagnostic; it does not establish equilibrium, validate AuroraPIC against eduPIC, or authorize a physics measurement.
